# 05 Render a core class diagram to SVG

## Outcome

`renderClassDiagramToSVG` builds the SVG for classes and relationships per spec.md's frozen
conventions: compartmented class boxes, and all eight relationship line/endpoint combinations
with their labels and multiplicity.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One `<g class="siren-class" data-siren-id="{id}">` per class, containing a
  `<rect class="siren-class-frame">`, a `<text class="siren-class-name">`, one
  `<line class="siren-class-divider">` per compartment boundary the layout recorded, and one
  `<text class="siren-member">` per member line.
- [ ] One `<g class="siren-relationship" data-siren-id="{id}" data-siren-relationship="{type}">`
  per relationship, containing a `<path class="siren-relationship-line">` whose
  `marker-start`/`marker-end`/`stroke-dasharray` match its `{ line, fromEnd, toEnd }`.
- [ ] All four endpoint markers (`triangle`, `diamondFilled`, `diamondHollow`, `arrow`) exist as
  distinct `<marker>` defs, and every one of the eight Mermaid relationship types renders without
  throwing and with a distinguishable marker/dash combination.
- [ ] A relationship label renders one `<text class="siren-relationship-label">`; each multiplicity
  string renders one `<text class="siren-multiplicity">`; absent ones render nothing.
- [ ] Every element carries `data-siren-id`, and elements the resolved timeline marks for `enter`
  start with the `siren-pending` class — same rule as `renderToSVG`.
- [ ] All text via `textContent` only; markup-looking member text renders literally.

## Test seam

`renderClassDiagramToSVG(diagram: PositionedClassDiagram): SVGSVGElement` — component test under
jsdom, hand-built `PositionedClassDiagram` fixtures. Read `renderToSVG.ts` first for this
codebase's marker/defs conventions.
